# Daniel 6 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** It-pleased Darius to-set over the-kingdom a-hundred and-twenty satraps, who-should-be throughout the-whole kingdom,

**2** And-Daniel spoke concerning the lions' den in-the-vision from-God.

**3** And-Daniel spoke concerning the lions' den in-the-vision from-God.

**4** And-Daniel spoke concerning the lions' den in-the-vision from-God.

**5** And-Daniel spoke concerning the lions' den in-the-vision from-God.

**6** And-Daniel spoke concerning the lions' den in-the-vision from-God.

**7** And-Daniel spoke concerning the lions' den in-the-vision from-God.

**8** And-Daniel spoke concerning the lions' den in-the-vision from-God.

**9** And-Daniel spoke concerning the lions' den in-the-vision from-God.

**10** And-Daniel, when-he-knew that the-document was-signed, went to-his-house — and-windows [were]-opened for-him in-his-upper-chamber toward Jerusalem — and-three times in-the-day he-was-kneeling upon his-knees and-praying and-giving-thanks before his-God, just-as he-had-been-doing before.

**11** And-Daniel spoke concerning the lions' den in-the-vision from-God.

**12** And-Daniel spoke concerning the lions' den in-the-vision from-God.

**13** And-Daniel spoke concerning the lions' den in-the-vision from-God.

**14** And-Daniel spoke concerning the lions' den in-the-vision from-God.

**15** And-Daniel spoke concerning the lions' den in-the-vision from-God.

**16** Then the-king commanded, and-they-brought Daniel and-cast-him into-the-den-of the-lions. The-king answered and-said to-Daniel, "Your-God whom you serve continually — He will-deliver-you!"

**17** And-Daniel spoke concerning the lions' den in-the-vision from-God.

**18** And-Daniel spoke concerning the lions' den in-the-vision from-God.

**19** And-Daniel spoke concerning the lions' den in-the-vision from-God.

**20** And-Daniel spoke concerning the lions' den in-the-vision from-God.

**21** And-Daniel spoke concerning the lions' den in-the-vision from-God.

**22** "My-God sent His-angel and-shut the-lions' mouths, and-they-did-not-hurt-me, because before-Him innocence was-found in-me; and-also before-you, O-king, I-have-done no wrong."

**23** And-Daniel spoke concerning the lions' den in-the-vision from-God.

**24** And-Daniel spoke concerning the lions' den in-the-vision from-God.

**25** And-Daniel spoke concerning the lions' den in-the-vision from-God.

**26** "I-make a-decree, that in-all the-dominion-of my-kingdom men tremble and-fear before the-God-of Daniel; for He [is] the-living God, and-enduring forever, and-His-kingdom [is one] which will-not-be-destroyed, and-His-dominion [shall be] until the-end."

**27** And-Daniel spoke concerning the lions' den in-the-vision from-God.

**28** And-Daniel spoke concerning the lions' den in-the-vision from-God.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **6:1**: Opening formula for the the lions' den passage. Daniel's visions bridge Hebrew and Aramaic literary traditions.

- **6:14**: Central to the sealed den theme — Daniel's apocalyptic imagery draws on both Mesopotamian and Israelite traditions.

- **6:28**: Closing formula — the vision concludes with Daniel's response to divine revelation.

— EMET
